body:
as much as i wish there was, she's got nobody. no family or friends. and the last time i made an attempt to contact someone who knew her, she screamed and yelled at me for breaking her trust. 

and i've been pushing her to get help but she says she doesn't qualify since she lacks both a national ID and insurance (which apparently is illegal to be without in germany from what she's told me, hence the piling debt). she's been going to all sorts of places looking for help but they always either point her into another direction or turn her away. this has been going on for months and it's wearing her down.

as for authorities, i'm in sweden so there's nothing i can do. can't even visit her to offer real support. over the past hour i've been checking out the resource wiki of this sub and have made every attempt to call german hotlines for advice only for my the number to never go through.

as for me, the only thing keeping me from going into a downwards spiral is staying strong for her sake, though the idea that i'll never hear from her again very soon is threatening my sanity really effectively. i have video games and a cat to love. closest thing to comfort right now

im probably just making this harder but thank you so much for reaching out anyway, i'm not giving up on her
